data_source: Curated from official government sources (pmjdy.gov.in, npscra.nsdl.co.in, jansuraksha.gov.in, nsiindia.gov.in, pmkisan.gov.in, mudra.org.in)

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
schemes.description: National financial inclusion program providing universal access to banking, insurance, and pension facilities.
schemes.description_hindi: राष्ट्रीय वित्तीय समावेशन कार्यक्रम जो सभी को बैंकिंग, बीमा और पेंशन सुविधाएं प्रदान करता है।

criteria: No existing bank account (or willing to transfer)
Age 10 years or above (minors with guardian)

required_documents: Aadhaar Card or Aadhaar Enrollment Slip
If no Aadhaar: Voter ID, Driving License, PAN Card, Passport, or NREGA Job Card
benefits: Zero balance savings account
RuPay Debit Card
Accidental insurance cover of 2 lakh rupees
Life insurance cover of 30000 rupees for accounts opened before January 2015
Overdraft facility up to 10000 rupees
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) linkage
schemes.how_to_apply: Visit nearest bank branch or Banking Correspondent (BC) outlet with Aadhaar card and photograph. You can also apply online through the bank's website.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.description: Government-backed pension scheme for workers in the unorganized sector, guaranteeing a fixed monthly pension of 1000 to 5000 rupees after age 60.
schemes.description_hindi: असंगठित क्षेत्र के कामगारों के लिए सरकार समर्थित पेंशन योजना, 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद 1000 से 5000 रुपये की मासिक पेंशन की गारंटी।

criteria: Must have a savings bank account
Must not be an income tax payer

required_documents: Bank account with active mobile number
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of 1000 to 5000 rupees after age 60
Government co-contributes 50 percent of the premium for 5 years (for those who joined before March 2016)
Spouse continues to receive pension after subscriber's death
Nominee receives the accumulated corpus
schemes.how_to_apply: Visit your bank branch where you have a savings account. Fill the APY registration form. You can also enroll through net banking or mobile banking apps.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
schemes.description: Accident insurance scheme providing coverage of 2 lakh rupees for accidental death or permanent disability at a premium of just 20 rupees per year.
schemes.description_hindi: दुर्घटना बीमा योजना जो केवल 20 रुपये प्रति वर्ष के प्रीमियम पर दुर्घटना मृत्यु या स्थायी विकलांगता के लिए 2 लाख रुपये का कवर प्रदान करती है।

criteria: Must have a savings bank account with auto-debit facility

benefits: Accidental death cover of 2 lakh rupees
Permanent total disability cover of 2 lakh rupees
Permanent partial disability cover of 1 lakh rupees
Annual premium of only 20 rupees, auto-debited from bank account
schemes.how_to_apply: Visit your bank branch or apply through net banking or mobile banking. Give consent for auto-debit of 20 rupees premium annually.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
schemes.description: Life insurance scheme providing coverage of 2 lakh rupees in case of death due to any reason at a premium of 436 rupees per year.
schemes.description_hindi: जीवन बीमा योजना जो किसी भी कारण से मृत्यु होने पर 436 रुपये प्रति वर्ष के प्रीमियम पर 2 लाख रुपये का कवर प्रदान करती है।

criteria: Must have a savings bank account

benefits: Life cover of 2 lakh rupees for death due to any cause
Annual premium of 436 rupees, auto-debited from bank account
Coverage from June 1 to May 31 each year
schemes.how_to_apply: Visit your bank branch, apply through net banking or mobile banking. Give consent for auto-debit of annual premium.

schemes.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
schemes.description: Government savings scheme for the girl child offering one of the highest interest rates among small savings schemes, currently 8.2 percent per annum.
schemes.description_hindi: बालिकाओं के लिए सरकारी बचत योजना जो लघु बचत योजनाओं में सबसे अधिक ब्याज दर प्रदान करती है, वर्तमान में 8.2 प्रतिशत प्रति वर्ष।

criteria: Girl child below 10 years of age
Only 2 accounts allowed per family (exceptions for twins or triplets)
Account opened by parent or legal guardian
Girl child must be an Indian resident

required_documents: Birth certificate of the girl child
Identity proof of the parent or guardian (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport)
Address proof of the parent or guardian
Passport-size photographs of the girl child and guardian
benefits: Interest rate of 8.2 percent per annum (as of Q1 FY2026)
Tax deduction under Section 80C on deposits up to 1.5 lakh rupees
Interest earned and maturity amount are tax-free
Minimum deposit of 250 rupees per year, maximum 1.5 lakh rupees
Account matures after 21 years from opening or on marriage after age 18
Partial withdrawal allowed after age 18 for higher education
schemes.how_to_apply: Visit any post office or authorized bank branch with the girl child's birth certificate, guardian's ID proof, and photographs. Fill the account opening form.

schemes.name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana
schemes.description: Income support scheme providing 6000 rupees per year in three installments to small and marginal farmer families.
schemes.description_hindi: छोटे और सीमांत किसान परिवारों को तीन किश्तों में प्रति वर्ष 6000 रुपये की आय सहायता प्रदान करने वाली योजना।

criteria: Not a current or former government employee (with some exceptions)

required_documents: Bank account details linked to Aadhaar
benefits: 6000 rupees per year in 3 equal installments of 2000 rupees
Installments credited directly to bank account via DBT
No restrictions on usage of the funds
schemes.how_to_apply: Register online at pmkisan.gov.in, through Common Service Centres (CSC), or visit your local Patwari or revenue officer. Self-registration through the PM-Kisan mobile app is also available.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
schemes.description: Loan scheme for micro and small enterprises providing collateral-free loans up to 10 lakh rupees under three categories: Shishu, Kishore, and Tarun.
schemes.description_hindi: सूक्ष्म और लघु उद्यमों के लिए ऋण योजना जो तीन श्रेणियों में 10 लाख रुपये तक का बिना गारंटी ऋण प्रदान करती है: शिशु, किशोर और तरुण।

criteria: Any non-corporate, non-farm small or micro enterprise

required_documents: Identity proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN Card)
Proof of business existence (if existing business)
benefits: Shishu: Loans up to 50000 rupees for starting a business
Kishore: Loans from 50001 to 5 lakh rupees for growing a business
Tarun: Loans from 5 lakh to 10 lakh rupees for established businesses
No collateral or guarantor required
No processing fee for Shishu loans
schemes.how_to_apply: Visit any nationalized bank, regional rural bank, cooperative bank, private bank, or micro finance institution. Submit the application form with business plan and required documents. You can also apply online through the Udyamimitra portal (udyamimitra.in).

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme
schemes.description: Provides bank loans between 10 lakh and 1 crore rupees to SC, ST, and women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading.
schemes.description_hindi: अनुसूचित जाति, अनुसूचित जनजाति और महिला उद्यमियों को विनिर्माण, सेवा या व्यापार में नए उद्यम स्थापित करने के लिए 10 लाख से 1 करोड़ रुपये तक का बैंक ऋण प्रदान करती है।

criteria: Must be SC, ST, or a woman
Not a defaulter to any bank or financial institution

benefits: Composite loan of 10 lakh to 1 crore rupees
Covers 75 percent of project cost (25 percent margin money)
Repayment period of up to 7 years
Moratorium period of up to 18 months
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at any Scheduled Commercial Bank branch. You can also register on the Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in) to connect with a bank in your district.
